Interface JsonValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
JsonArray, JsonBoolean, JsonNull, JsonNumber, JsonObject, JsonString
public sealed interface JsonValue permits JsonObject, JsonArray, JsonString, JsonNumber, JsonBoolean, JsonNull

A JSON value. Values are immutable and thread-safe.

Two values are equal when they are of the same type and hold equal contents: objects with the same members, whatever their order; arrays with the same elements, in the same order; numbers with the same numeric value, so that 1, 1.0 and 1e0 are equal. Object.toString() returns the value as compact JSON.

Since:
0.1.0
